news.title: Nvidia's Huang dismisses fears AI will replace software tools as stock selloff deepens
news.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismissed fears that artificial intelligence will replace software and related tools, calling the ​idea "illogical", after a significant selloff in global software stocks on ‌Tuesday.  The selloff, partly sparked by AI developer Anthropic's updated chatbot release last week that ‌heightened fears of AI-driven disruption in the data and professional services industry, broadened on Wednesday, hitting software stocks in India, Japan and China.  Speaking at an artificial intelligence conference in San Francisco hosted by Cisco Systems ⁠Huang said worries that AI ‌will make software companies less relevant are misguided and AI will continue to rely on existing software rather ‍than rebuild basic tools from scratch.
